integration_assessment.adapter_model: diagnostics.logging.v1 adapter over package:logging LogRecord streams
strengths: no runtime package dependencies at the evaluated stable release
named loggers, levels, errors and record stream are adapter-friendly
Library can own redaction, persistence and remote Diagnostics transport
weaknesses: does not provide persistent history itself
does not provide a remote diagnostics transport itself
component lives inside a monorepo and the adapter must retain pkgs/logging component identity
additional_costs: define Library-owned structured event projection without inventing contract semantics
connect the event stream to the existing redaction/persistence/Diagnostics adapters

reasons: diagnostics.logging.v1 is a logical boundary only
stable logging-v1.3.0 is pinned to an immutable verified commit
the package moved to the active official dart-lang/core monorepo
minimal pure-Dart event API avoids forcing a diagnostics backend
manual proof does not substitute for V1 security admission

recommendation: RESEARCH SHORTLIST. Preferred minimal diagnostics.logging base, pending engine security admission and Library normalization.
